sources.note: Adobe Illustrator CC 2015, created 4 Mar 2016, PDF title Linjekart for T-banen gjeldende fra 3. april 2015, author Ruter, keywords linjekart, T-bane, linje 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. sources.role: live-board path (official Entur Journey Planner v3 — not wired)
sources.title: Journey Planner v3 (GraphQL)
sources.note: Official next-train / departure-board path for Norway including Ruter T-bane. Header ET-Client-Name as next-train-app (NLOD open service; unidentified clients rate-limited). Query stopPlace { estimatedCalls } and filter transportMode metro / authority Ruter. Returns aimed / expected / actual, cancellations, destinationDisplay.frontText, quay, situations. Jernbanetorget and Nationaltheatret are multimodal stop-places (T-bane + rail + bus) — doNotGroup. D1 stays planned.

sources.role: D1 board-eligibility oracle for Vy regional/commuter rail and Flytoget (added 30 Aug 2026)
sources.title: Oslo oracle-clash-report.md — Board eligibility section
sources.note: Tim's board-eligibility decision (30 Aug 2026): Vy regional/commuter rail (RE10, RE11, R12, R13, R14, R21, L1, L2) and Flytoget (FLY1, FLY2) both pass the two boarding-contract tests in docs/board-eligibility-rule.md (walk-up, no compulsory reservation; no check-in barrier) at Jernbanetorget and Nationaltheatret. Evidence: Vy seat-reservation policy page (reservations optional/supplementary on regional trains); Flytoget conditions of carriage (ticket does not automatically entitle a seat = no compulsory reservation); Bane NOR station pages for Oslo S and Nationaltheatret confirm no check-in barrier at these stations (Flytoget's customs/barrier only applies at Oslo Airport Station itself, not in this catalog). Scope is these two stations only — the oracle report gives official terminus-pair naming for direction chips, not stop-level data for the rest of each corridor.

sources.role: live-board path (official Entur SIRI / GTFS-RT for codespace RUT — not wired)
sources.title: Real-Time Data — codespace RUT (Oslo region / Ruter)
sources.note: RUT has SIRI ET + SX and GTFS-RT Trip Updates + Service Alerts. No SIRI VM and no GTFS-RT Vehicle Positions for RUT. Header ET-Client-Name. SIRI Lite rest/et limited to 4 req/min; use publish/subscribe for higher rate. Static Entur GTFS for RUT is NOT a D1 generator. reise.ruter.no / Ruter-appen is the passenger UI on top of Entur, not a product contract. D1 stays planned.

Modes v1: TRAIN-like = T-bane / metro lines 1–5 (all 101 stations) PLUS Vy regional/commuter rail (RE10, RE11, R12, R13, R14, R21, L1, L2) and Flytoget (FLY1, FLY2), both scoped ONLY to Jernbanetorget and Nationaltheatret (added 30 Aug 2026 per Tim's board-eligibility decision — see oracle-clash-report.md Board eligibility section). No trikk, no bus, no ferry, no passenger line 6, no Fornebubanen. Vy/NSB trains are no longer blanket-excluded — only the Vy lines and stations listed above are in scope; the rest of the Vy network stays out.
Timezone Europe/Oslo HAS DST (CEST/CET). Do not copy no-DST cities.

Five printed T-bane lines on the official Ruter index and 2024 folder cover: 1 Frognerseteren–Bergkrystallen; 2 Østerås–Ellingsrudåsen; 3 Kolsås–Mortensrud; 4 Vestli–Bergkrystallen; 5 Sognsvann–Vestli. No line 6.

Locked inner-city printed name: Stortinget (T-bane only; all five lines; line 5 official through-path calls it twice around Ringen). Not Oslo, not City, not Sentrum (map blob), not Jernbanetorget (T-bane + Vy + Flytoget, three-way doNotGroup, bussterminal stays out), not Nationaltheatret (T-bane + Vy + Flytoget, three-way doNotGroup), not Majorstuen (west mouth of the Common Tunnel, T-bane only). doNotGroup T-bane vs Vy vs Flytoget at Jernbanetorget and at Nationaltheatret — three separate platform/board sections, not two.

101 unique passenger-open T-bane stop strings (matches the published 101-stasjon network). 174 line ticks (line 5 Stoppestedsliste lists the ring-then-spur with Stortinget / Majorstuen / Tøyen / Carl Berners plass twice, same pattern as a published loop-then-spur folder).

Gulleråsen is a map tick and a line-1 westbound Stoppestedsliste row; eastbound Frognerseteren–Bergkrystallen skips it (Stopp i pilretningen). Ullevål stadion not Ullevaal. Carl Berners plass not Carl Berner. Nationaltheatret not Nationaltheateret. Jernbanetorget is the T-bane string — never Oslo S as the metro stop.

gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown are passenger codes 1–5 printed on the Ruter index (Entur RUT:Line:1 style ids are feed metadata — not print locks) for T-bane, and the printed Vy/Flytoget line codes (RE10, RE11, R12, R13, R14, R21, L1, L2, FLY1, FLY2) for the newly in-scope lines. No stopIds in this file.

Feed / live (Jim D2, not a D1 generator): Official Entur Journey Planner v3 stopPlace.estimatedCalls and SIRI ET datasetId=RUT for T-bane. For Vy, Entur GTFS/SIRI filtered to datasetId=VY. For Flytoget, Entur GTFS/SIRI filtered to datasetId=FLY. Header ET-Client-Name on all three. Static Entur GTFS is NOT a D1 generator for any of the three. D1 stays planned. assertCityLive("oslo") must fail.

Vy and Flytoget scope (added 30 Aug 2026): mapGroup Vy / mapGroup Flytoget lines below are scoped ONLY to Jernbanetorget and Nationaltheatret — their stations[] arrays list just those two stops, not the full corridor (Drammen, Lillehammer, Skien, Eidsvoll, Kongsberg, Dal, Asker, Kongsvinger, Moss, Spikkestad, Lillestrøm, Stabekk, Ski, Oslo Airport Station are NOT in this catalog; no stop-level data for them is sourced). Call order between Jernbanetorget and Nationaltheatret is not asserted — the oracle report's Board eligibility table lists them in different orders for Vy rows vs Flytoget rows, which reads like table-authoring order, not a sourced sequence. Do not infer a direction from stations[] array order for these lines.
